identity.title: Neck pinch singularities and Joyce conjectures in Lagrangian mean curvature flow with circle symmetry
identity.journal: Journal of the European Mathematical Society

actual_source_version.comments: 27 pages, 6 figures; changes to proofs of Propositions 3.4 and 4.2, plus other minor changes, accepted in JEMS
actual_source_version.limitation: Exact pinned author manuscript; publisher PDF unavailable through the normal public link. Differences from publisher text have not been compared.

findings.title: Inconsistent preliminary Gibbons–Hawking powers
findings.decisive_evidence: Printed alpha_i=I_i(phi^-1 eta) yields diag(1,phi^-1,phi^-1,phi^-1) in a g-orthonormal frame. Combining(a),(c) yields gE=phi^-1 delta; one-centre phi=1/(2r) gives scalar curvature -5/(4r^3), not flat.
findings.alternative: Not OCR; pinned TeX matches. Standard metric(2.4) already has the correct form.
findings.impact: Local normalization inconsistency; no established failure of core flow written using(2.4).
findings.repair_status: Consistent alpha_i=I_i(phi^-1/2 eta), gE=phi^-1 sum alpha_i² and metric volume normalization supplied.

findings.title: Gradient evolution omits moving-metric terms
findings.decisive_evidence: Circle-invariant open annulus in shrinking product circles, u+v modulo2pi in(-delta,delta), has global grading theta=u+v+pi, |dtheta|²=2/R², time derivative4/R⁴, Hessian0 and Laplacian norm0.
findings.alternative: A whole product torus is not graded and is not used. Example is genuinely graded and almost calibrated, but is a local identity test, not compact main-theorem counterexample.
findings.impact: False auxiliary equality; direct later curvature derivation remains valid and no essential downstream use identified.
findings.repair_status: Remove or supply correct moving-metric Bochner formula; flat extra 2|A(gradient theta,.)|² identified, ambient curvature also needed generally.

findings.title: Convexity first-contact argument leaves its sign domain
findings.decisive_evidence: At first positive-time zero of f+epsilon*t, f=-epsilon*t<0, whereas inequality used holds only where f>=0.
findings.alternative: No counterexample to Proposition3.4 is claimed. Exact f_t=a f_ss+(kappa partial_N a+a kappa²)f gives a complete repair under its smooth compact bounded-curvature assumptions.
findings.impact: The invalid first-contact contradiction is used in Proposition 3.4, explicitly invoked by Theorem 4.13 (p19), hence Theorem 4.14 and the compact examples of Theorem 1.1(b). Proposition 3.4 is also explicitly invoked by Corollary 5.5 (p22), used by Theorem 5.9(b) (p24) and Theorem 1.4(d) (p3). This is demonstrated proof-level harm to central contributions. The supplied local repair restores convexity on the stipulated smooth compact bounded-curvature intervals, separately from the original proof assessment; the full global results are not recertified.
findings.repair_status: Verified analytic replacement on smooth compact time intervals: exact f_t=a f_ss+b f with bounded b=kappa*partial_N(a)+a*kappa^2, zero endpoint values, exp(-K*t)f with K>sup|b|, negative-minimum contradiction and interior strong maximum principle. Does not certify continuation across singular times or weaker endpoint regularity.

findings.title: Nonnegative curvature statement includes stationary straight lines
findings.decisive_evidence: Single centre0, phi=1/(2|x|), gamma_t(s)=(s,1,0) is embedded, avoids centre and solves gamma_t=phi^-1 kappa N with kappa=0 for all time.
findings.alternative: The statement also incorrectly includes t=0 for general nonnegative initial curvature. Its prefaced future-study role does not establish use in the main compact theorem.
findings.impact: Overbroad auxiliary strict-positivity proposition, not a principal theorem counterexample.
findings.repair_status: Exclude identically straight case and use t>0; appropriate noncompact maximum-principle hypotheses still required rather than certified here.
